purpose: Diagnose output suppression versus public representation using complete training games only. No candidate promotion or policy learning.
loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
decision_rule: Report representative and full-phase results, fitting versus excluded-family late errors, all phases/styles and family folds. Both existing evaluation distributions remain required. Neither endpoint-only gains nor aggregate scores establish acceptance. No mass sweep or evaluation-label access.
scope: Training-only fixed50/50loss-mass comparison between uniform states and the existing phase representative within each fitting game-phase. Preserve each game-phase total weight and all zero weights on excluded families. Same corrected data, public features and model configuration as the named baseline. Tree uses one seed because prior two seeds produced identical predictions. Neural uses its original two seeds. No acceptance thresholds or evaluation sampling changes.
